'''Vultures''' were carrion [[Bird/Legends|birds]]. Varieties were found on many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. [[Pirate/Legends|Pirates]] and [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] were often compared to vultures.

==Species of vulture==
*[[Rock-vulture/Legends|Rock-vulture]] of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].
*[[Jyykle vulture]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].
